mapper.select:
select a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover_image as coverImage, a.category, a.author_id as authorId, a.author_name as authorName, a.views, a.comments, a.likes, t.liked_at as likedAt, t.collected_at as collectedAt, t.action_time as actionTime from ( select article_id, max(case when action_type = 'liked' then action_time end) as liked_at, max(case when action_type = 'collected' then action_time end) as collected_at, max(action_time) as action_time from (
select article_id, create_time as action_time, 'liked' as action_type from article_like where user_id = #{userId} union all
select article_id, create_time as action_time, 'collected' as action_type from article_collect where user_id = #{userId} union all
) u group by article_id ) t join article a on a.id = t.article_id order by t.action_time desc
